title: Doozy Vape Co Tropical Slush Nicotine Salts
description: Tropical Slush has become a hugely popular flavour thanks to its sugary-sweet, fruit syrup base. With the addition of tangy pineapple, however, Doozy Vape Co’s Tropical Slush becomes something even more special, with even more juicy flavour and irresistible character. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
